parts.label: Column
parts.note: Carries the building load down to the foundation

parts.label: Pile cap
parts.note: A thick concrete block that spreads the load to the piles

parts.label: Pile
parts.note: Long concrete columns driven or bored into the ground

parts.label: Soft clay
parts.note: Too weak to carry the load near the surface

parts.label: Dense sand
parts.note: Firmer, but still not enough on its own

parts.label: Bedrock
parts.note: Strong rock where the piles end

parts.label: Pile toe
parts.note: End bearing: the toe rests on the rock

parts.label: Water table
parts.note: Below this level the soil is full of water
